coreMemory.english: aux. used to express a weak or uncertain possibility；aux. used to make a cautious suggestion；aux. used with have for an uncertain or possible past action

meanings.english: used to make a cautious suggestion
meanings.example: We might be able to finish the update today.

synonyms.difference: may 侧重“可能；也许”。对应的常用英文义是 “used to express a weaker possibility or tentative suggestion”。might 在本卡搭配“might do something”中表达“可能”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“可能”这个义项下，certainly will（肯定会）与 might 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of might”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。
